The company marks senior secured notes to fair value using discount rates derived from UK gilt redemption yields plus credit spreads based on ICE BofAML indices, with discount rates updated monthly and applied daily, and may adjust spreads for private placement market divergence, which can materially affect published fair value NAVs.
